summary: Deterministic evidence-first code quality & zero-hallucination production-readiness audit for Antigravity IDE and GuroGen AI workspaces.

findings.title: Unprotected Global State Fallback Guard in Custom Hooks
findings.description: Ensure state arrays undergo defensive array type checking before array operations to prevent null dereference errors.

evidence.snippet: 39. **Defensive Zero-Undefined Data Law (`DEFENSIVE-ZERO-UNDEFINED-LAW`)**: EVERY array mutation or iteration method (`.unshift()`, `.map()`, `.filter()`, `.push()`, `.slice()`) across ALL components and client SDK proxies MUST enforce defensive array checks.

proposed_fix.explanation: Enforce array defensive guards via static ESLint rule and defensive default initializers across client components.

findings.title: Deterministic Zod Model Output Validation Gate
findings.description: Validation harness for AI model audit outputs successfully implemented and verified against repository file trees.

evidence.snippet:

proposed_fix.explanation: Integrated Node.js Zod validation runner into CI pipeline for zero-hallucination attestation.
